options.name: label
options.description: Visible label and accessible name; clicking it toggles the switch.

options.name: hideLabel
options.description: Visually hide the label; it remains the accessible name.

options.name: checked
options.description: Initial on/off state; also restored by reset().

options.name: validationTiming
options.description: When a custom error message first appears; afterwards it updates live.

properties.name: host
properties.description: Consumer host; its children are owned by the component.

properties.name: validity
properties.description: Always valid unless a custom error is set.

properties.name: dirty
properties.description: State differs from the initial state.

properties.name: touched
properties.description: Focus has left the control at least once.

methods.name: setChecked
methods.description: Programmatic state (no events); clears an external custom error.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show a custom error now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error, for example a failed save; cleared when the user toggles.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial state and clear dirty/touched/submitted state.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove rendering, listeners, registration, and subscriptions.

cssClasses.name: aui-switch__control
cssClasses.description: Positioning wrapper for the track and thumb.

cssClasses.name: aui-switch__input
cssClasses.description: Native input, restyled as the track.

cssClasses.name: aui-switch__thumb
cssClasses.description: Decorative thumb; its position shows the state.
